answer: Sequential VDF stamp: every identity must deliver a 5-hour serial hash chain each epoch, so 1,000 fakes cost 5,000 machine-hours per epoch. The chain is seeded from the live mesa beacon, so nothing is precomputed; the haven checker re-verifies 20 random segments, and a broken link or two keys sharing one jade checkpoint voids both. Extra cores give a farm nothing, since a serial chain cannot be split; it needs one dedicated machine per fake. Limit: faster chips shorten it, so difficulty retunes each epoch.
